ultimately: in the end; when nothing else is left
We will all help, but it is you who are ultimately responsible.
ultimate: The ultimate goal, success, decision, etc. is the final one.
You can't have ultimate success without a lot of little successes.
The ultimate test, responsibility, power, etc. is the one that is more important, bigger, stronger, etc. than the others.
They are trying to build the ultimate computer, one that can do anything and everything.
ulcer: An ulcer is a painful area inside your stomach, mouth or skin. that fails to heal and may have unpleasant liquid.
ultraviolet: waves (light) that are ultraviolet are higher in frequency than violet waves. They are outside of the visible spectrum and can't be seen with your eyes.
ultrasound: Ultrasound is the sound with a frequency greater than the upper limit of human hearing.
Ultrasound is the use of ultrasonic waves for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.
ultrasonic: If something is ultrasonic, it is of a higher in frequency than the upper limit of human hearing.
ultrafast: If something is ultrafast, it is very fast or done in a very short amount of time.
